summary: Recursion Pharmaceuticals filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a marketed follow-on offering of 61,540,000 Class A common shares at $3.25 per share, raising $200.0 million gross and $188.0 million net before expenses. The October 15, 2026 pricing compares to a $3.74 close on October 14, a 13.1% discount. Leerink Partners, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Evercore ISI and Needham are underwriters, with closing expected October 16, 2026. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch post-deal dilution and trading pressure.
